product_brief: A FIPS 140-3 validated software only cryptographic module implementing functions for Symantec Encryption products.
pqc_capability_description: No mention of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms or support in the provided text.

fips_validated: Yes, FIPS 140-3 validated software only cryptographic module. First Validated: 6/22/2026.
primary_platforms: Debian 11, MacOS 15, RHEL 9, Windows 11, Windows 11 Pro 24H2
